answer:
**CD14 monocytes (CD14 Mono)** have the highest number of significantly differentially expressed genes after AAV9 mini-dystrophin treatment: **315 of the 316 genes tested** in that cell type pass BH-adjusted p < 0.05 (p_val_adj < 0.05) in the Post-vs-Pre contrast — **152 up-regulated and 163 down-regulated** post-treatment. Runners-up: CD16 monocytes (240 significant DEGs: 59 up / 181 down) and NK cells (118: 91 up / 27 down); the next closest are CD4 TCM (58) and CD4 Naive (30). For context, four cell types (Eryth, pDC, Plasmablast, Platelet) have zero significant DEGs, and the total across all 25 cell types is 952 significant DEGs.

Caveat on direction: the up/down split assumes avg_log2FC is computed as Post-AAV minus Pre-AAV (i.e., positive log2FC = higher after treatment), inferred from the file name "PostvsPre_DEG_tables" and from sign(avg_log2FC) matching sign(pct.1 − pct.2) in ~99% of rows; if the convention were reversed, the up/down split would swap but the total count per cell type — and therefore the answer — would be unchanged.
